            if pos + frame_length <= len(payload):\
                frame_payload = payload[pos:pos+frame_length]\
                sink.store(frame_payload)\
                total_stored += frame_length\
                pos += frame_length\
            else:\
                break\
        return Receipt(stored=total_stored)/' ./app/service.py
